rule: Every loop is owned and closed by a server-side worker. A client session (a code agent, a chat, a person's machine) is only ever a producer of work; it never completes, merges, deploys, resolves, archives or files the follow-up for a loop. The worker that dispatched or created the work owns verifying and closing it.
owner_directive: Rowan, 2026-11-13: close all open loops autonomously and server side; client side agents never complete loops; server side agents own the loops they create.
executor_role: A code agent is a producer. The dispatching worker records the dispatch, verifies the result through an independent path and closes (merge when green, retry, or a tracked item with owner, trigger and probe).

handback.why: a timer that waits on the session that opened the PR; the server repairs or supersedes it at once
waits on somebody outside the server to clear a label

handback.pattern: \b(the |its |pr )?(author|opener|opening session|client session|submitter) (must|should|needs? to|has to|is expected to|will) (fix|rebase|resolve|merge|close|follow|finish|complete|update|re-?run)\b
handback.why: names the session that opened the loop as its closer
tells a client session to stay alive to close its own loop
assigns loop closure to a client-side agent
a server step that idles on a client

excused_note: A line may hold a hand-back phrase only to state or cite the rule (the marker on the same line) or to forbid it (never, is a defect).

exclude.reason: patch files quote sibling repositories byte for byte

wiring.why: the merge lane adopts every pull request it cannot merge on the same pass

adopt.label: server-owned

states.ci-failed: A check failed on the head commit. Read the failing run, then land the same change so that every check passes: push a fix to the branch, or open a new pull request from main that carries the change and close this one as superseded.
states.conflict: The branch conflicts with main. Merge main into the branch and resolve it, or redo the change from main in a new pull request and close this one as superseded.
states.held: The automatic review held this pull request on a High finding (see its comment). Open a new pull request from main that carries the change without the finding, then close this one as superseded.
states.needs-pat: The pull request changes .github/workflows/** and no workflow-capable credential is bound (foundation/data/needs-you.json, lane-credential). Land every file outside .github/workflows/ in a separate pull request now, so only the workflow change is left behind the credential.

adopt.why: GitHub Issues are off on this repository (QUEUE-1), so the sweeper's Q-OPENLOOP issue cannot be filed and the executor reads docs/issues only. The lane files the tracked item there, on the pass that finds the pull request unmergeable, with no age threshold.
